title: DevOps vs SRE vs CloudOps: Roles and Career Map | DevOps & SRE Zero to Hero Day 5
description:
DevOps engineer, SRE or cloud engineer: what is the real difference? Day 5 explains what each role owns, where platform and DevSecOps fit, how SLOs and error budgets work, and which career path fits you, with real terminal checks for each role.

I'm Shivam Singh Verma, a DevOps & SRE engineer with 5 years of experience building CI/CD pipelines, running cloud infrastructure on AWS & GCP, and managing projects.

📺 Day 5 of 100 · DevOps & SRE Zero to Hero: a free course with a new episode every Thursday at 8 PM IST.

🔑 What you'll learn
• What a DevOps engineer owns
• Where SRE came from (Google) and what an SRE owns
• What CloudOps owns: IAM, cost, health, compliance
• Platform engineering and DevSecOps in one minute
• DevOps vs SRE vs CloudOps side by side
• Error budget maths: 99.9% = 43.2 minutes a month
• One incident shared across three roles
• A common career path and how to choose
• A 20-second interview answer
